articles.headline: Kyle Walker on chasing promotion with Burnley - 'I am not becoming anyone's meme'
articles.description: Kyle Walker has insisted that he will not become "anyone's meme" as he begins his second campaign with Burnley.

images.name: Kyle Walker [1296x729]
images.alt: Burnley's Kyle Walker in action during the Carabao Cup first round match at Turf Moor, Burnley. Picture date: Saturday August 8, 2026. (Photo by Richard Sellers/PA Images via Getty Images)
images.credit: Photo by Richard Sellers/PA Images via Getty Images

articles.headline: Parkinson reflects on Wrexham's 'roller coaster' rise to Premier League hopefuls
articles.description: Phil Parkinson reflects on Wrexham's rise since Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney purchased the club five years ago.

images.name: Parkinson reflects on Wrexham's 'roller coaster' rise to Premier League hopefuls
images.caption: Phil Parkinson reflects on Wrexham's rise since Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney purchased the club five years ago.

articles.headline: Tom Brady watches on as Birmingham lose Vertu Trophy final to Peterborough
articles.description: Birmingham City were dealt a shock 2-0 defeat by Peterborough United in the Vertu Trophy final at Wembley Stadium on Sunday, with NFL legend and minority owner of the club Tom Brady watching on.

images.name: Tom Brady [1296x729]
images.caption: Tom Brady (centre) could only watch on as Birmingham City lost in the Vertu Trophy final on Sunday.
images.alt: Director Andrew Shannahan, Interim Chief Executive Officer Jeremy Dale, Minority Shareholder Tom Brady and Chairman Tom Wagner look on from the box following Birmingham City's defeat during the Vertu EFL Trophy Final match between Birmingham City and Pet

images.name: Peterborough [1296x729]
images.caption: Hector Kyprianou celebrates after putting Peterborough 2-0 up at Wembley Stadium.
images.alt: ector Kyprianou of Peterborough United celebrates after scoring a goal to make it 0-2 during the Vertu EFL Trophy Final match between Birmingham City and Peterborough United at Wembley Stadium on April 13, 2025 in London, England

articles.headline: Wrexham lose on pens to Peterborough in EFL Trophy semifinals
articles.description: Wrexham have missed a golden opportunity to play a final at Wembley Stadium after losing to Peterborough United on penalties in the EFL Trophy semifinals.

articles.headline: Wrexham one win from Wembley as they beat Bolton in EFL Trophy
articles.description: Wrexham are one win away from a trip to Wembley after they earned a narrow win over Bolton Wanderers in the quarterfinals of the EFL Trophy on Tuesday.

images.name:
Bolton Wanderers' Eoin Toal competes with Wrexham's Jack Marriott during the Vertu Trophy Quarter Final match between Wrexham and Bolton Wanderers at Racecourse Ground
 [1296x729]
images.alt: Bolton Wanderers' Eoin Toal competes with Wrexham's Jack Marriott during the Vertu Trophy Quarter Final match between Wrexham and Bolton Wanderers at Racecourse Ground
images.credit: Richard Martin-Roberts - CameraSport via Getty Images
